## Wave 4 Summary

This wave resolves the single genuine Q1a adversarial tension surfaced by the investigation-3 seed: the framework's #1 standing gap, **M_KK-DERIVATION**, is read OPPOSITELY by two seed authors. The spectral-geometer (heat-trace / scale-normalization vantage) reads the spectral triple as scale-free — it predicts the dimensionless `Ô`'s and predicts NO absolute scale; M_KK is fixed only by external G_N-matching, and the STAGE-3-PERMANENT NNU rank-1 theorem (§VII.BS) confirms every dimensionful observable shares one un-fixed weight `w = M_KK`. The paasch-mass-quantization-analyst (mass-phenomenology vantage) reads Paasch's absolute-mass machinery (mass integers N(j)=7n, M(j)=√N(j), the proton-cubic at n3=dim(3,0)=10, deriving m_p to Δm/m≈5e-7 as an ABSOLUTE value) as a candidate ANSWER to M_KK-DERIVATION once the observationally-dead Dirac-G~1/t scaffolding is severed. These are *opposed readings of the same gap* — the structural prerequisite for a workshop per `Investigating-Workshops.md` (TWO agents, genuine ledger-dissonance, multi-round, structural verdict). This wave carries exactly ONE `gate_type: workshop` gate (INV3-W4-1); it translates seed item D1 (`Cross-agent convergences` #1).

INV3-W4-1 is a workshop gate; it has NO compute prerequisite verdict. Its `sources` (both surveys' G1 sections + the §VII.BS theorem text via the knowledge MCP + the `M_KK` canonical pin) are all already on disk / queryable at dispatch — no upstream investigation-3 gate must land first. The workshop MAY reference the *candidate* compute INV3-W3-4 (the Casimir-graded N(j)=7n test, Wave 3) as the decisive-forward-gate candidate in sub-question (c), but it does NOT depend on INV3-W3-4 having run: the workshop adjudicates whether that compute (or some other) is the decisive one, it does not consume its verdict. If a cited source deliverable is somehow absent at dispatch, the gate honestly closes per `mechanical-closure-discipline.md`.

## Wave 4 → (investigation close) Decision Point

INV3-W4-1 is the terminal wave. On landing (workshop md present with all three must_contain sections), the structural verdict propagates to `/rclab-investigate --investigation 3` close per the routing below:

- **LIVE-CORRIDOR verdict** → the named decisive forward gate (candidate INV3-W3-4 or a refinement) is lifted as the leading carry-forward into the next session-mode `/rclab-plan` (M_KK-DERIVATION is EVOI's single highest-leverage standing gap; a live corridor is the keystone-lift path). The verdict is an investigation finding; promotion into the permanent register requires a session-track re-compute (`gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"` track-local boundary).
- **PROVEN-IMPOSSIBLE-WALL verdict** → recorded as the investigation's structural finding; routes a session-promotion candidate to annotate the §VII.BS / EVOI §6 standing-gap framing (a curated-register prose touch is session-track, NOT an investigation edit — flagged to housekeeping §B at close, designated-writer per `feedback_framework-hygiene.md`). The seconds-valued a(t)-gap is then a structural feature, not an open derivation.
- **SCOPED-INTERMEDIATE verdict** → the scoping (e.g. value-derivable / normalization-not) + its decisive forward gate route as above; the verdict's exact scope governs which session-track follow-on is queued.

The workshop's own `## Carry-Forward Computations` block is the canonical carrier of the decisive forward gate (4-field spec); `/rclab-investigate` lifts it. No verdict line is emitted at any branch (workshop closure is artifact-existence).

## Wave 4 Machinery-Enumeration Pin

INV3-W4-1 is a `gate_type: workshop` gate with NO producing script — it contributes NOTHING to the compute/solo `machinery_pin_map` aggregate that `_yaml_gate_validator.py` reads for the numeric subset. Its pre-registration IS the `workshop:` block (agents / rounds / sources / output_path / adjudication_question / context) + the artifact-existence `output_artifacts`. Per `plan-investigation.md §"Investigation-specific"`, a workshop gate is NOT PRU-vulnerable for lacking a numeric threshold; it is validated by its workshop block + artifact-existence closure, the same split `wave-classification.md §M1` applies to METHODOLOGY-class waves.
